title: Inverse Cell Centroid and Barycentric Localization
negative_results: localize_cell refuses a face_id outside 0..19 and an octal digit outside 0..7
localization is deterministic across repeated calls

claims.statement: localize_cell maps an address (face, octal path) to the spherical cell it names, returning the cell corners, the unit centroid direction, and the cell diameter, without inventing sub-cell point precision.
refine_then_localize returns a cell that contains the original direction (POWER), and the cell diameter shrinks by a factor between 0.4 and 0.6 (~1/2) per refinement depth.
A cell centroid is a representative of a synthetic cell, not a decoded destination. SOURCE_VECTOR_GEOGRAPHIC_SEMANTICS_NOT_CLAIMED; PHYSICAL_VALIDATION_NOT_CLAIMED.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs
